text:

text: We could get a tiny MU next to KSU with all the colleges but it will be a tight fit.

text: And it's under attack.

first_order: fighting off kU to keep the MU going
text: I've been trying to fight off kU to keep our MU going.

text: I'm working on it too. definitely an uphill battle. The M is currently in good shape, but the U is F'd

first_order: encouraging the good fight
text: Yeah it's tough. Keep up the good fight.

first_order: praising getting the beakers to try elsewhere
text: Boss move getting the beakers to try elsewhere.
author: EveryTrueSon

first_order: saying they are in deep
text: I'm in deep, man.

first_order: asking for help widening the black border against encroachment
text: I'd like to increase the black border around the top and left side by a pixel. Anyone willing to help with that effort? I think it will help ward off encroachment
author: EveryTrueSon

first_order: agreeing to help while questioning work on the U
text: Sure, I don't know what people are doing with the U right now.
author: MizGunner

first_order: proposing building around the U before fixing inside
text: It seems like vandals are targeting the U more than anything, which is fine. we should build out around it and then fix inside.
author: EveryTrueSon

first_order: reporting MST trying to turn the U into an S and add a T
text: Apparently MST is also griefing, so they're trying to change the U to an S, and put a T underneath
author: -PM_ME_UR_SECRETS-

first_order: mocking the chickenhawks' scrambled image
text: Man, the chickenhawks are struggling over in college corner. they're all kinds of scrambled next to the N of nowledge.
author: EveryTrueSon

first_order: suggesting a white border that people might respect
text: Should we put a white border near it? Sometimes people respect those.
author: MizGunner

first_order: calling the work good and proposing a logo-like white border
text: We're doing really good. Let's try to get a white border around it so that it looks like the logo
author: -PM_ME_UR_SECRETS-

first_order: worrying about space and suggesting an alternating border
text: My concern with the border is we don't have space on the right without making the flag look like it's bleeding. maybe alternating white/gold border?
author: EveryTrueSon

first_order: avoiding Pakistan's retaliation after losing other images
text: Yeah, I don't want Pakistan to retaliate. They took out my IZ, and ZOU. Along with the entire Rangers Logo.
author: MizGunner

first_order: saying Pakistan is ready to rumble
text: Yeah, Pakistan is ready to rumble here.
author: EveryTrueSon

first_order: proposing using the flag as a border
text: I saw we use the flag as a border. Let's build a white border on the left side so that there are 2 black blocks in between it and the letters.
author: -PM_ME_UR_SECRETS-

first_order: agreeing to the white-border suggestion
text: Yes
author: compasrc

first_order: planning to secretly trim Pakistan's flag by one row
text: Okay here's the plan, we secretly decrease the whit part of Pakistan's flag by 1 row of black pixels. That will let us do what we need to do.
author: compasrc

first_order: scaling the border plan to the people available
text: Realistically, we can't compete with the Pakistan flag. I vote one block of black all the way around, then we clear white space around that. Our right side will have 2 blocks of black until we figure out if we want to try a border. There's just not enough of us to do maintenance and build out right now.
author: EveryTrueSon

first_order: ending by praising those who took and defended the spot
text: Looks like Place is over. Proud everyone who not only fended off kU for that spot, but those that helped take it from them initially. Unfortunately Belgium was just too much.
author: MizGunner

first_order: inviting people to laugh at the rival subreddit
text: If you want a laugh, visit their subreddit and see the posts venting frustration about not being able to get on the map.
author: MizGunner

first_order: calling out kU for conspiring against Mizzou
text: kU conspiring against us in r/place!
author: -PM_ME_UR_SECRETS-

first_order: asking 5-10 people to shore up the MU for 20 minutes
text: We need 5-10 people to just make the effort for the next 20 minutes and they'll get bored and move on. Shore up the MU and they'll see they can't win.
author: EveryTrueSon

first_order: asking for help against jayhawks vandalizing the sprite
text: There are at least three jayhawks currently vandalizing our sprite. Could use some help here!

first_order: going to sleep outgunned and hoping the MU survives
text: I'm outgunned and need some sleep. Hopefully the MU is there in the morning.
